newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range today on a lack of market-moving news. State-run commercial banks based in Shanghai and Beijing were net lenders.
"The market rates are likely to continue to move narrowly around the current levels in the short term because there is no fresh stimulus around the corner," said one trader.

Traders said although short-term money supply was sufficient at the national level, supply on the market is down recently with some local financial organisations lending out less money to prepare for possible new T-bill issues in the near future.
